Implement the Runners Diary frontend using React, TypeScript, Vite, React Router, TanStack Query, and the selected component and form libraries in `docs/PROJECT_BRIEF.md`. Use the generated API client only for backend communication; do not hand-roll parallel API contracts.

Preserve keyboard accessibility, calendar ARIA semantics, responsive usability, English-first localization structure, bookmarkable month URLs, and the distinct visual treatment of planned and completed runs. Add or update relevant UI tests. Do not add secrets or expose map subscription keys in browser code.
